$comment: Wave 6 lane 6A's sibling table (the wave 6 base, plans/toolkit_wave6_plan.md section 2.0, part 3): how derm delivers the agent's own sandbox for the Standard tier, per agent (contracts/sandbox.md). presets.rs and contracts/presets.ts merge each value into its row as `sandbox`. Shape: contracts/harness-presets.schema.json, $defs.sandbox. Each row was run at its verifiedAt in the cloud on 12 Nov 2026 (Linux, bubblewrap 0.9.0 and socat; plans/parallel/tk_lane_6A.md, Research) except cursor, read in its bundle on the Mac by the wave 6 base (note AZ 8.3) and not run. gemini has no row: its per-tool sandbox is not verified (note AZ A11).

claude-code.note: derm's block is the last --settings of the command line (Claude Code reads only the last); file tools, MCP servers and hooks run outside the sandbox, under derm's gate (note AZ A7). A user or managed file's sandbox keys merge with the block, so derm refuses them.

codex.note: default_permissions="derm" and permissions.derm as -c pairs at derm's own -c level (case 184); a config layer that defines [permissions.derm] merges into it, so derm refuses one. Run with codex exec on Linux; macOS's Seatbelt under this profile is a Mac test step.

cursor.note: Cursor's CLI merges ~/.cursor/sandbox.json with a repository's .cursor/sandbox.json, and no flag loads a settings layer derm could own (note AZ A6, read, not run), so derm cannot hold the tier: derm run --tier standard says so and runs the Whole tier.
